summary: Företag 15 develops bio-based edible coatings that extend the shelf life of fruits and vegetables and help reduce food waste. The company focuses on sustainable alternatives to conventional plastic packaging for fresh produce.
strategy_notes: Focused on commercializing sustainable shelf-life extension solutions and scaling adoption across the fresh produce supply chain.
technology_notes: Develops bio-based edible coatings designed to preserve freshness, reduce spoilage and decrease reliance on plastic packaging.
risk_notes: Dependent on customer adoption, regulatory compliance, manufacturing scale-up and competition from existing food preservation and packaging solutions.
